description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Import the business website into the knowledge profile in the background: returns the queued import; poll ringkit_get_latest_knowledge_import until done or failed. Only fields that are still empty are filled; uploaded documents are never touched. An unfinished import is returned instead of starting another. Identical requests are deduplicated for 24 hours; use a new idempotencyKey only to deliberately repeat the action.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_start_knowledge_import
title: Start website import
